[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-el[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Durable agent-CLI update history in the Admin Center Agent CLIs [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]sub-tab[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every sase-managed agent-CLI update run is recorded to a durable, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bounded journal, and the Agent CLIs sub-tab renders that history [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]beneath the selected CLI's detail panel — per-CLI by default, with [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a toggle to a run-grouped timeline across all CLIs — without any [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]disk I/O on the keystroke path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]agent_cli_update_history.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/agent_cli_update_history.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-el[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-el/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Durable agent-CLI update run journal[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]journal[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]journal: add the bounded JSONL run journal under ~/.sase/logs, define [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the run/entry records and the UpdateTrigger enum, record every run from [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the single execute_agent_cli_updates choke point with a best-effort [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]writer that can never fail an update, and thread the trigger through the[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]three call sites.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pane load path, config, and session state[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]plumbing[dim] · [dim][/dim]after journal[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plumbing: read a bounded tail of the journal inside the existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]off-thread Updates load worker, carry it on PluginsLoadResult into pane [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]state, add the two ace.updates config keys and the session-scoped [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]history-scope flag, and mount the history Static with its TCSS so the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]render phase has a surface to paint into.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]History panel rendering and scope toggle[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]render[dim] · [dim][/dim]after plumbing[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]render: build the per-CLI and all-CLIs history renderables with their [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]glyph/color palette, relative timestamps derived from the load clock, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]trigger badges, truncation footer, and empty/error states, and wire the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]H scope toggle with its check_action gating and repaint path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Help, docs, and visual goldens[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]polish[dim] · [dim][/dim]after render[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]polish: document the panel and journal in the help modal, the ACE guide,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the agent-providers guide, and the configuration reference, record the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]three new PNG goldens, and land a green just check.[/#D7D7AF]
